name: Shattered Strand
summary: The Shattered Strand is a wild, rugged coastline flanking the northern rim of the Bay of Storms in Azshara. Dominated by crashing surf and crumbling ancient ruins, the beach crawls with hazardous marine beasts and tribal aquatic creatures.

sections.title: A Treacherous Coastline
sections.body: Stretching along the northern edge of the Bay of Storms, the Shattered Strand is far from a peaceful shoreline. The rocky beaches and tidal shallows are heavily inhabited by aggressive wildlife, including towering sea giants, multi-headed hydras, and snapping makrura, alongside encampments of coastal murlocs. Crumbling elven architecture overlooks the waves, anchored by landmarks such as the ancient Temple of Arkkoran and the solitary Tower of Eldara. For travelers navigating Azshara's treacherous cliffs, descending to this isolated strip of coast means confronting some of the region's deadliest amphibious threats.

faq.q: Where is the Shattered Strand located?
faq.answer: The Shattered Strand forms the northern coast of the Bay of Storms, situated in the eastern reaches of Azshara beneath the zone's towering clifftops.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Shattered Strand?
faq.answer: The shoreline is heavily prowled by vicious hydras, massive sea giants, armored makrura, and clusters of hostile murlocs patrolling the tidal flats.

faq.q: What notable ruins can be found along the beach?
faq.answer: The coast is home to ancient highborne architecture, most prominently the Temple of Arkkoran and the nearby Tower of Eldara overlooking the bay.

faq.q: Is the Shattered Strand safe for casual exploration?
faq.answer: No. The beach is isolated, difficult to escape quickly due to the surrounding sheer cliffs, and tightly packed with predatory aquatic beasts and powerful giants.

angles.text: The strand offers an untamed proving ground filled with formidable hydras and coastal beasts, ideal for those seeking powerful beasts or studying the predatory fauna of the Kalimdor coast.
